Its integral Smith diagonal is eight 1 entries and five zero entries. The resulting CW complex has exactly one vertex and cells only in dimensions 4 and 5; integral basis changes on attaching maps yield 88 S4 and 5 S5. Independent full finite-field boundary ranks agree over primes 2,3,5. Tests are finite and exhaustive for the stated one board, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: Uniform capacity two in four rows is a canonical first four-row torsion regime. The six-column boundary is a pure five-dimensional complex yet has 88 essential four-spheres and 5 five-spheres: it is nonshellable but integrally torsion-free immediately adjacent to the established seven-column order-two-torsion case. The result is an exact homotopy classification, not a routine Euler or finite-field rank; a reusable complete Morse certificate explains the geometry.
